Job Title: Lead Instructor: AI-Enabled Product Marketing Manager

Company: General Assembly

Client: Confidential – Customer Success Reskilling

Location: Remote (Must work West Coast / Pacific Time hours)

Duration: 2 Weeks (Starting Mid-June)

Commitment: Roughly 30 hours per week

Compensation: $11,500 - $15,500 (Estimated lump sum payment for one 60-hour program)

About the Engagement

General Assembly is delivering an intensive reskilling program designed to transition experienced Customer Success and Account Management (CSAM) professionals into AI-Enabled Product Marketing Manager (PMM) roles.

As the Lead Instructor, you will be responsible for guiding these professionals as they learn to own the positioning, messaging, and launch strategy for enterprise AI offerings. You will help them bridge the gap from relationship management to strategic product marketing, ensuring they can effectively market complex tools like Copilot and Azure AI Foundry.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Live Instruction: Deliver high-energy, synchronous remote lectures on PMM fundamentals, including AI positioning frameworks, messaging, and persona development.
  • Facilitate Strategy Workshops: Guide students through hands-on "build-along" activities where they create messaging frameworks, competitive intelligence reports, and launch strategy documents.
  • Storytelling & Messaging Mentorship: Leverage the learners' existing customer-facing strengths to help them craft compelling, AI-driven customer stories and value propositions.
  • Review Market Deliverables: Provide expert, actionable feedback on student projects focused on launch motions and market-entry activities for AI products.
  • AI Tool Integration: Teach students how to comfortably use analytics and AI content tools to iterate on messaging and improve marketing efficiency.

What You Bring

  • The Experience: 7+ years in product marketing, with at least 2+ years of recent experience specifically positioning and launching AI-powered products at an enterprise scale.
  • Strategic Mastery: Deep expertise in the "PMM core": positioning, messaging, personas, and go-to-market (GTM) launch motions.
  • The "Teacher" Gene: Proven experience coaching, mentoring, or instructing professionals. You must be able to translate high-level marketing strategy into digestible, practical steps for a remote cohort.
  • Tech Fluency: A strong understanding of the Microsoft AI ecosystem (Copilot, Azure AI, and Foundry) and how these tools compete in the current market.
  • The Credentials: AI-900 certification is required.
  • The Pedigree: Experience as a Senior PMM or Director of PMM at a major tech firm (Microsoft, Google, etc.) is a significant plus.

Note on Schedule: This is a high-intensity, 2-week engagement starting in mid-June. The instructor must be fully available for 30 hours per week and must operate on Pacific Time (PT) business hours to align with the learner cohort.

Unless otherwise noted, remote positions can be performed from the following approved General Assembly operating countries.

United States of America (states of operation may vary), Canada (provinces of operation may vary), United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore.

You will design and implement reliable, high-performance solutions that improve inventory visibility, order fulfillment, and warehouse execution. You will leverage Azure cloud technologies, Kubernetes, and data integration platforms to modernize applications, optimize system performance, and deliver business value. This role is focused on maintaining highly available cloud-native applications, troubleshooting production issues, and improving operational excellence. You will work closely with engineering teams to monitor service health, investigate incidents, and ensure reliable service delivery.

  • Monitor application health, availability, and performance.
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents using logs, monitoring, and debugging tools.

  • Strong knowledge of Splunk for log analysis and debugging.

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and distributed systems.

Job Title: Automation Digital Product Manager

Job Location: Work at Home, Texas, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

As an Automation Digital Product Manager within the Automation Center of Excellence, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of automation opportunities, from intake and discovery through deployment and continuous optimization.

This role is accountable for owning intake, feasibility assessment, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, and delivery execution, while ensuring strong alignment with business objectives. You will partner closely with business stakeholders to understand their operating models, core processes, challenges, and pain points, and translate those insights into a prioritized and sustainable pipeline of automation opportunities.

You will also play a critical role in nurturing business relationships, proactively expanding the automation portfolio, and ensuring continuous value delivery to business organizations through automation and process optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Business Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders across supported organizations

  • Act as a trusted partner and advisor, deeply understanding business needs and priorities

  • Proactively nurture business relationships to grow the automation backlog and expand impact

  • Identify opportunities to drive additional value through automation and process improvements

  • Regularly engage stakeholders to align on priorities, roadmap, and delivery progress

Intake, Discovery & Opportunity Identification

  • Lead intake and feasibility efforts by engaging with business stakeholders to:

    • Understand core processes, workflows, and operating models

    • Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and challenges

  • Identify and shape new automation opportunities aligned to business needs

  • Build and document end-to-end process workflows and process maps

  • Define and document:

    • Problem statements

    • Scope of automation

    • Business requirements and expected outcomes

  • Develop business case value, including efficiency gains, cost savings, and operational impact

Automation Roadmap & Prioritization

  • Partner with business stakeholders to shape and manage automation roadmaps for supported business groups

  • Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on value, complexity, and strategic alignment

  • Own and manage the opportunity pipeline and product backlog

  • Lead backlog refinement to ensure readiness and clarity for development

End-to-End Opportunity Delivery Ownership

  • Own and manage the full lifecycle of automation opportunities, from intake through delivery and post-production support

  • Develop detailed delivery plans, including:

    • Timelines and milestones

    • Resource planning and hours allocation

  • Perform and validate effort estimates across requirements, development, and testing

  • Track and report status, progress, risks, and outcomes to leadership (LT) and business stakeholders

  • Proactively identify, manage, and resolve risks, dependencies, and blockers to ensure successful delivery

Requirements & Product Management

  • Lead requirements gathering in close partnership with business teams

  • Translate requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications

  • Own backlog management, prioritization, and refinement

  • Facilitate user story reviews and secure business sign-off prior to development handoff

  • Ensure clear, structured handoff of requirements to technical teams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, automation SMEs, and business teams to drive delivery

  • Serve as the bridge between business and technical teams, ensuring alignment and clarity

  • Manage dependencies across cross-functional teams

Automation Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track KPIs and success metrics to measure automation value

  • Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess outcomes and identify enhancements

  • Lead continuous improvement efforts, including:

    • Process optimization initiatives

    • Creating enablement materials (e.g., demo videos, walkthroughs)

    • Supporting adoption and knowledge sharing

Innovation & Emerging Technology Enablement

  • Contribute to solutions leveraging:

    • Artificial Intelligence (AI)

    • Agentic automation frameworks

    • Robotic Process Automation (RPA)

    • Web-based applications

  • Utilize prompting tools and AI techniques for analysis, day to day activities and solution support

  • Apply hands-on experience with modern AI tools, such as:

    • Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio

    • GitHub Copilot

    • Claude and other large language model–based tools

    • Emerging AI platforms and productivity tools

  • Support innovation initiatives and experimentation with new technologies

Domain Expertise Development

  • Build and maintain deep knowledge of supported business domains and processes

  • Act as a subject matter expert and strategic advisor to business stakeholders

  • Continuously enhance understanding of industry trends and automation best practices

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in in Product Management, Product Ownership, and Project Management

  • Proven ability to manage end-to-end lifecycle of automation or digital products

  • Strong expertise in:

    • Process analysis and business discovery

    • Requirements gathering and documentation

    • Backlog prioritization and roadmap management

    • Agile/Scrum methodologies

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • RPA solutions

    • AI and intelligent automation technologies

    • Web application delivery

  • Experience working with modern AI tools such as:

    • Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools

  • Experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, including executive-level reporting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong process mapping and data analysis capabilities (e.g., Power BI)

  • Certifications in Agile, Business Analysis, or RPA platforms

Education

raw.excerpt: WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers. We're just over 2 years old, and more than 7 million teachers from all over the world have joined our platform. Join a top team at a fast growing company that is working towards real social impact. Make an account and try us out at our website and connect with our passionate community on our Wall of Love.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market - Texas, you will lead critical partnerships across midsized school districts in the state to ensure our tools reduce teacher burnout and accelerate student learning at scale. As a Texas market expert and commercial lead, this consultative position involves managing a multimillion-dollar book of business. Key responsibilities include driving customer adoption and leading renewal efforts within the unique Texas educational landscape.

You will oversee complex onboarding and renewal processes, coach teachers and administrators through change, and design interventions that boost adoption.

This role is regional, meaning you should live in Texas and/or bring extensive experience in Texas EdTech (understanding TEA/SBOE dynamics) to be considered for this role.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will own a portfolio of school and district relationships and be responsible for driving the following measurable outcomes:

  • Portfolio Growth and Retention: You will manage a portfolio of approximately 50-75 mid-market districts while maintaining a Net Revenue Retention (NRR) rate above target through strategic price increases and seat expansion.

  • Product Adoption: You will drive active usage across your districts by delivering high-impact training and implementation strategies and creating compelling support materials, such as tutorials and one-pagers, that ensure implementation is scalable and our tools become essential to daily teacher workflows.

  • Churn Mitigation: You will identify at-risk accounts and execute intervention playbooks to maintain a gross churn rate below company thresholds, specifically focusing on a 90 day action plan for high-stakes renewals.

  • Multi-Stakeholder Discovery and Solutioning: You will run structured discovery across district roles and map MagicSchool solutions to each persona's priorities to drive multi-threaded engagement.

  • Strategic Relationship Management: You will build deep trust with district executive leadership, managing accounts through data-driven storytelling and consultative selling.

  • Leadership and Mentorship: You will scale our collective impact by contributing high level insights to the Customer Success playbook, driving cross functional strategy in leadership meetings, and mentoring junior team members to elevate the entire regional organization.

  • Key Metrics of Success

    • Revenue Retention (GRR, NRR)

    • Churn Rate

    • Pilot conversion

    • Expansion Growth

    • Operational Excellence

Qualifications/Competencies/Skills

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring the following skills and competencies:

  • Ownership Mentality: You take full responsibility for your portfolio, working with a high degree of urgency and a bias toward action.

  • Commercial Fluency: You are comfortable leading complex financial negotiations, including discussing contraction risks, pricing adjustments, and expansion opportunities.

  • Texas K-12 Expertise: You possess a deep understanding of the Texas educational landscape.

  • Relationship-Driven: You build deep trust with teachers and district leaders alike.

  • Team Selling Approach: You operate as the "CEO of your accounts," proactively identifying internal resources and mobilizing cross-functional partners to deliver without waiting to be asked.

  • Consultative Discovery and Multi-Stakeholder Management: You run structured discovery across senior district roles (Director of Technology, C&I, ELL, cabinet), translate what you learn into prescriptive, persona-aligned recommendations, and guide district leaders toward the right solution rather than reacting to requests.

  • Book Segmentation & Prioritization: Independently segment your book by ARR, strategic influence, and use case potential to focus time where it drives the most impact.

  • Executive Communication: You are concise, credible, and compelling with senior district leaders. You inspire confidence through clarity.

Experience

Required

  • 3 - 7 years of experience as an individual contributor managing mid-market or enterprise accounts in a SaaS environment, ideally in EdTech

  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding NRR and GRR targets

  • Direct experience leading commercial conversations across renewals, expansion, and pricing

  • Comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder organizations and building relationships at the executive level.

  • Technically proficient in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

  • Willingness to travel within the state as needed to support district relationships (30%).

Preferred

  • Background in education as a former teacher, coach, or school administrator, a plus

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology that directly impacts educators and students.

  • Join a mission-driven team passionate about making education more efficient and equitable.

  • Flexibility of working from home, while fostering a unique culture built on relationships, trust, communication, and collaboration with our team - no matter where they live.

For full time employees:

  • Unlimited time off to empower our employees to manage their work-life balance. We work hard for our teachers and users, and encourage our employees to rest and take the time they need.

  • Choice of employer-paid health insurance plans so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Dental and vision are also offered at very low premiums.

  • Every employee is offered generous stock options, vested over 4 years.

  • 401k match & monthly wellness stipend.

Our Values:

  • Educators are Magic: Educators are the most important ingredient in the educational process - they are the magic, not the AI. Trust them, empower them, and put them at the center of leading change in service of students and families.

  • Joy and Magic: Bring joy and magic into every learning experience - push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

  • Community: Foster community that supports one another during a time of rapid technological change. Listen to them and serve their needs.

  • Innovation: The education system is outdated and in need of innovation and change - AI is an opportunity to bring equity, access, and serve the individual needs of students better than we ever have before.

  • Responsibility: Put responsibility and safety at the forefront of the technological change that AI is bringing to education.

  • Diversity: Diversity of thought, perspectives, and backgrounds helps us serve the wide audience of educators and students around the world.

  • Excellence: Educators and students deserve the best - and we strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

Compensation Range: $104K - $120K

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


The Opportunity: Controller

Tilt is looking for a Controller to lead our accounting operations and build the infrastructure to support public company readiness. Reporting to the Head of Accounting, you'll lead a team of accountants and be the operational backbone of our finance function, partnering closely with FP&A, Legal, and other stakeholders to ensure our financial house is built to last. This is a role for a hands-on leader who thrives on building — someone who wants their fingerprints on how a company scales.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Own the Close: Lead all aspects of US accounting operations and consolidation, delivering accurate, timely financial statements in accordance with GAAP.

  • Build for Scale: Redesign the accounting operations from the ground up, establishing best practices, standardizing processes, and creating the infrastructure needed to support IPO readiness and beyond.

  • Strengthen the Control Environment: Design, implement, and maintain a robust system of internal controls that safeguards assets, ensures reporting integrity, and meets SEC and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead and Develop the Team: Manage and mentor a team of accountants, while also rolling up your sleeves as an individual contributor where needed.

  • Champion an Automation Mindset: Identify where AI and automation can uplevel the team — shifting work from manual preparation to high-judgment review and analysis.

  • Serve as a Key Financial Liaison: Coordinate with internal stakeholders, external auditors, regulators, and investors, ensuring clear and transparent communication on the company's financial position.


Why You're a Great Fit

  • Financial services background required — you've worked in a fintech or consumer credit environment and understand the nuanced accounting that comes with it.

  • 10+ years in accounting/finance, with experience in a leadership role; you're equally comfortable as a manager and as someone who still gets their hands dirty.

  • NetSuite power user — you can configure, optimize, and get the most out of the platform without outside help.

  • Operator at heart — you've rebuilt or stood up accounting operations before and know what "good" looks like for a company on the path to IPO.

  • Curious about automation — you don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be excited about what it means for the future of accounting and eager to bring that thinking to the team.

  • SQL familiarity is a plus — comfortable reading queries and working cross-functionally with data and FP&A teams.


Our Interview Process

  1. Initial recruiter call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.

  2. Hiring manager interview: A deeper discussion about your background and approach to solving challenges.

  3. Skills panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach through real-world scenarios.

  4. Leadership conversations: Conversations with our CFO and CEO to discuss our mission and how you could contribute to it (and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way).

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

  • Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

  • Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

  • Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

  • Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

  • Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

  • A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

  • Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

  • Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

  • Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

  • Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

  • An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

raw.description:
About the Role

A fast-growing robotics startup building rugged, multi-mission Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) for hazardous environments — spanning emergency response, industrial operations, and defense — is looking for an Electrical Engineer to design and own the electrical backbone of their robots.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at a small, high-caliber team (backgrounds include NASA, Lockheed Martin, and top defense research institutions). You'll work directly across mechanical and software disciplines to deliver field-ready systems that perform under extreme real-world conditions. Visa sponsorship is available.

What You'll Do

  • Design analog and digital circuits including power regulation, signal conditioning, and sensor interfaces.

  • Own full PCB development — schematic capture, layout, and bring-up.

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical and software engineers to ensure reliable system integration.

  • Troubleshoot and debug system-level electrical issues across hardware and software boundaries.

  • Define and maintain wiring diagrams, harnessing, grounding schemes, and EMI/EMC strategies.

  • Support sensor selection and integration across modalities: thermal, gas, visual, RF, and more.

  • Run and interpret tests for thermal load, EMI, and mechanical ruggedness.

  • Design and fabricate cable harnesses and enclosures optimized for field reliability.

  • Run SPICE simulations for analog validation, noise analysis, and circuit stability.

  • Contribute to design reviews and maintain clear documentation for design decisions.

  • Help establish internal electrical standards and test infrastructure for future product iterations.

  • Engage directly with end users as needed to inform engineering direction on specific features.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on electrical design experience for robotics or embedded systems, covering analog/digital circuits, power distribution, and sensors — this is a dealbreaker requirement.

  • Proficiency with schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium, KiCad, or Eagle.

  • Experience with embedded systems development, board bring-up, and debugging.

  • Experience designing robot bus and wiring harness systems, including full harness development.

  • Strong cross-functional fundamentals — comfortable working across hardware, software, and mechanical teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with thermal, EMI, and vibration testing and debugging in robotics hardware.

  • Hands-on soldering, lab assembly of boards, and wiring harness assembly.

  • Sensor integration experience on robotics platforms.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $100,000 – $150,000 USD annually

  • Visa sponsorship available

Location

This role is on-site in Austin, Texas. Candidates must be available to work in-person full time.

raw.description:
Ease is hiring an Account Executive to help manufacturers improve quality, safety, and operational performance through our category-leading plant floor audit platform.

In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close, while partnering with some of the world's leading manufacturing organizations. You'll join a growing team, sell a proven solution with strong market traction, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both our customers and the company's continued growth.

Position Summary
As an Account Executive at Ease, you’ll own the full sales cycle for enterprise manufacturing prospects, from first conversation to signed contract. You’re the first face these organizations see, and the impression you leave sets the tone for everything that follows. You’ll build relationships across the org, from the plant floor to the C-suite, and you’ll understand the difference between the two audiences well enough to speak to both without changing your conviction.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to move qualified deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up to win. If you’re a hunter who also knows how to build trust, asks better questions than you give answers, and measures success by the deals that actually close: this one is for you.

Salary: $200k+ OTE

What You'll Do:
  • Prospect, qualify, and engage enterprise-level manufacturing organizations. You’re not waiting for leads to come to you. You know your ICP, you know where to find them, and you know how to earn the first conversation.
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline. The majority of it will be self-sourced. Quality over volume. Know what’s real and what’s wishful, and have the discipline to tell the difference. A clean pipeline is a credible pipeline.
  • Run discovery that goes deeper than features and functions. Understand what a quality or safety problem actually costs the people in the room. Not just the business on paper, but the plant manager who’s been dealing with it for two years.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations that are tailored, not templated. The demo should feel like it was built for that customer, because it was. Show them their world in the product, not a generic walkthrough.
  • Partner with Marketing and Customer Success to move deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up for long-term success. The close isn’t the finish line. It’s the starting line.
  • Stay sharp on the manufacturing landscape: the pressures, the priorities, and the language of the people you’re selling to. The best reps in this space earn credibility on the plant floor, not just in the boardroom.
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospecting through close. Negotiate with confidence, manage multiple stakeholders across the org, and drive deals to a decision, in either direction. Knowing when to walk away is part of the job.

Required Qualifications & Skills:
  • 3+ years of experience in a closing role, with a track record of winning new business in enterprise-level accounts. You know what it takes to move a complex deal and you’ve done it more than once.
  • Strong communication skills, but more importantly, strong listening skills. You ask the right questions and know how to create space for the prospect to arrive at the answer themselves.
  • Competitive and accountable, without needing external pressure to stay on track. You set your own standard, and it’s a high one. You also know when to walk away from the wrong deal and redirect your energy.
  • A consultative approach to discovery. You understand that the personal cost of a problem is just as important as the business case. You know how to find both, and you know how to connect them to the people making the decision.
  • Genuine curiosity about the manufacturing sector. You don’t need to be an industry veteran, but you need to be the kind of person who wants to understand how things are made, where the problems live, and what keeps a plant manager up at night.
  • Comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles. You know how to keep momentum without pushing. You build relationships across the org, not just with the person who signs the paper.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.

About Ease
Ease digitally transforms plant floor audits around the world with EASE. The enterprise-grade mobile platform combines simplicity and efficiency with powerful performance insights, driving quality and safety on the plant floor.

Industry leaders, including Aston Martin, Dana, 3M, Tenneco, and Samsung, trust EASE to facilitate and analyze millions of plant floor audits every year. With deployments in over 40 countries, EASE supports more than 25 languages, solidifying its position as a category leader for quality management, as recognized by G2 and Gartner.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, Ease. is a dynamic company that recently secured a growth investment from Luminate Capital Partners, further fueling its robust growth trajectory.

What We Offer
At Ease, we foster a culture built on respect, humility, and collaboration. We value work-life balance as a core principle, help ing ensure you can thrive both professionally and personally. And yes—we believe work should be fun, too.

Growth and development are part of our DNA. We are committed to investing in your career through ongoing training, mentorship, and a clearly defined path forward. Whether you are sharpening existing skills or exploring new ones, you will have opportunities to learn and advance.

We prioritize the well-being and happiness of our team. In addition to a competitive compensation package, we offer a generous and comprehensive suite of benefits designed to support your health and peace of mind.

Here’s a look at what you can expect:
  • Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Life & AD&D Insurance: Financial protection for you and your loved ones
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off: Time to recharge and rest when you need it
  • 401(k) with Employer Match: Plan for your future with confidence through our matched retirement savings program
At Ease, we believe that when our employees are supported, inspired, and empowered, everyone wins.

raw.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Brand & Integrated Marketing to lead Roo’s brand team and shape how the veterinary community experiences Roo across channels, audiences, and touchpoints.

This role is responsible for leading the team that brings Roo’s brand to life across content, social, community, PR, events, campaigns, web, paid channels, and more. You’ll help create the narratives, creative systems, and signature moments that make Roo’s brand feel clear, cohesive, meaningful, and unmistakably Roo.

You’ll lead a growing brand team across brand/content, social/community, and events, while helping guide external partners across PR, design, web, ads, and other brand programs. You’ll work closely with teams across the business to ensure Roo’s brand shows up thoughtfully, creatively, and consistently across the full customer journey.

Responsibilities

Brand & Campaign Leadership

  • Set the strategic direction for Roo’s brand team, translating business and marketing priorities into focused brand strategies, compelling campaigns, and elevated creative direction.
  • Lead integrated campaigns from audience insight and messaging through creative direction, channel planning, execution, measurement, and iteration.
  • Elevate the quality, clarity, creativity, and visual consistency of Roo’s brand work across major campaigns and everyday touchpoints.
  • Use performance data, audience insights, and campaign learnings to improve how brand work is planned, prioritized, and measured.
  • Grow Roo’s reach across social, community, events, content, and emerging channels.
  • Develop brand-led programs and moments that build stronger connection with vets, techs, hospitals, and the broader veterinary community.
  • Bring creative ideas to new channels, formats, and audience opportunities while keeping Roo’s brand consistent and high-quality.

Thought Leadership & External Storytelling

  • Shape Roo’s brand narrative across core audiences, ensuring our story is clear, credible, and relevant to the veterinary community.
  • Lead thought leadership programs, including industry reports, customer stories, executive visibility, authored content, speaking opportunities, and other high-impact storytelling moments.
  • Partner with PR to support earned media, industry moments, press angles, and proof points that strengthen Roo’s credibility.
  • Conduct ongoing brand and audience research to track awareness, perception, and engagement, and translate insights into stronger messaging and storytelling.
  • Identify opportunities to evolve Roo’s voice, messaging, and market-facing story as our audiences and business goals grow.

Team & Partner Management

  • Lead and develop a growing brand marketing team across brand/content, social/community, and events.
  • Guide the work of external partners across PR, design, web, ads, and other creative needs, ensuring output is aligned to Roo’s strategy, voice, and quality bar.
  • Partner with teams across Roo to bring brand guidance, messaging, and promotional support to customer-facing programs, launches, and moments.
  • Create scalable systems, templates, and ways of working that help the team and company activate the brand consistently.
  • Use AI and emerging tools thoughtfully to improve research, workflow, content development, reporting, and team efficiency while maintaining strong human judgment and Roo’s quality bar.

Qualifications

  • You have experience in brand marketing, integrated marketing, campaign marketing, or a related role, with experience leading multi-channel work from strategy through execution.
  • You’ve managed and developed teams, including direct reports and external partners or agencies.
  • You understand how brand shows up across the full customer journey, from major campaigns to everyday channel execution.
  • You’re a strong storyteller with creative judgment, a clear point of view, and an eye for visual consistency, brand cohesion, and elevated execution.
  • You’re highly collaborative and work across teams, build trust, and bring people along through clear communication and strong relationships.
  • You use data, research, and performance learnings to make better decisions, sharpen strategy, and drive measurable impact.
  • You bring curiosity and creative energy to the work, with a desire to keep testing new ideas, formats, channels, and ways of reaching audiences.
  • You’re thoughtful about where AI and emerging tools can improve the way marketing teams work, while knowing where human judgment and creativity matter most.
  • Experience in veterinary medicine, healthcare, tech, marketplaces, labor platforms, or mission-driven companies is a plus.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

For permanent, full time employees, we offer:
  • Accelerated growth & learning potential.
  • Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.
  • Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.
  • 401K
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • Paid Maternity/Paternity and reproductive care leave.
  • Gifts on your birthday & anniversary.
  • Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.
Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.
We have diverse, passionate & driven team members from a variety of backgrounds, and Roo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Key Responsibilities

Community & Ideas Forum Management

  • Manage the Ideas Forum as a strategic Voice of Customer channel, ensuring timely review, response, and status updates for customer-submitted ideas.
  • Review, triage, and evaluate customer feedback to determine relevance, product scope, duplicate submissions, implementation status, and support-related inquiries.

  • Drive continuous improvement of the Ideas Forum by maintaining high-quality, actionable customer feedback.

Customer Council Program Management

  • Lead the operational management of the Customer Council program, fostering meaningful collaboration between enterprise customers and internal product teams.

  • Partner with Product Managers, User Experience teams, Experience Researchers, and cross-functional stakeholders to gather discussion topics, feature validations, and customer feedback requests.
  • Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, supporting documentation, and presentation materials.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Customer Council participants, building strong professional relationships and encouraging ongoing engagement.
  • Support customer recruitment, onboarding, and retention activities for the Customer Council program.
  • Facilitate customer discussions alongside internal stakeholders while capturing detailed meeting notes, customer insights, feature requests, and validation outcomes.
  • Synthesize qualitative customer feedback into actionable recommendations that support product planning and decision-making.
  • Track action items, customer requests, follow-up commitments, and program deliverables through completion.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, customer feedback repositories, meeting records, and reporting dashboards.
  • Develop recurring reports highlighting customer sentiment, emerging trends, product feedback, and strategic opportunities.

Must-Have Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in community management, customer success, customer support, program management, product feedback management, market research, user research, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing external customer relationships within a professional environment.
  • Strong customer success expertise with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Hands-on experience using CRM platforms to manage customer interactions and engagement activities.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to synthesize qualitative feedback, identify trends, and generate actionable insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to facilitate meetings, develop agendas, and coordinate follow-up activities.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Experience analyzing qualitative customer feedback and identifying recurring themes and opportunities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across Product Management, User Experience, Research, and Operations teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience managing customer advisory boards, customer councils, beta programs, user communities, or customer engagement programs.
  • Experience supporting SaaS products, enterprise software platforms, or technology organizations.
  • Familiarity with product development lifecycles and roadmap planning.
  • Experience collaborating with Product Managers, UX Researchers, Designers, Customer Success, or Product Operations teams.
  • Knowledge of enterprise licensing, account administration, or customer account management platforms.
  • Experience preparing executive-ready reports, customer feedback summaries, and presentation materials.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Timely and consistent management of Ideas Forum submissions.
  • Accurate maintenance of customer feedback status and lifecycle tracking.
  • Increased customer engagement across community channels.
  • Successful execution and growth of the Customer Council program.
  • Delivery of high-quality meeting agendas, summaries, and action tracking.
  • Strong relationships with customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Clear synthesis of Voice of Customer insights that influence product decisions.
  • Improved visibility and accessibility of customer feedback across internal teams.

Overview

Who We Are

Dendreon is pioneering the future of immunotherapy. For over a decade, we have harnessed the power of the patient’s own immune system to fight cancer. Our flagship cellular therapy and growing pipeline are grounded in a simple belief: the immune system holds the key to transforming cancer care.

Headquartered in Seal Beach, California, with major operations in Union City, GA and Seattle, WA, we are now expanding our impact through contract manufacturing, patient operations, and commercial excellence in cellular immunotherapies. We are a purpose-driven organization that puts patients first and raises the bar every day.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Associate Director, Market Access & Reimbursement to lead strategy and execution for optimal patient access, reimbursement, and commercial success of our innovative oncology therapies. This critical leadership role will shape how payers, providers, GPO’s, distributors, and patients experience Dendreon’s products across all sites of care.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Align with leadership in Commercial department to develop and execute comprehensive market access and reimbursement strategies to secure favorable coverage, coding, and payment for Dendreon’s cellular immunotherapies.
  • Lead pricing, contracting, and gross-to-net activities, including payer and channel negotiations, government pricing compliance (Medicare Part B/D, Medicaid, 340B), and forecasting support.
  • Drive buy-and-bill and site-of-care strategies across urology, community oncology, academic centers, and hospital outpatient settings.
  • Oversee channel and distribution management, including relationships with specialty distributors, specialty pharmacies, GPOs, IDNs, and oncology networks.
  • Lead and develop the Field Reimbursement team and patient support programs (HUB services, prior authorization support, patient assistance).
  • Assist in leading both new hire and on-going commercial team training efforts
  • Partner closely with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Government Affairs to align market access efforts with brand strategy and product launches.
  • Attend national and regional conferences, using the opportunity to engage with thought leaders and important customers
  • Monitor reimbursement trends, resolve access barriers, and deliver insights to support business performance and patient access.
  • Represent Dendreon in payer and provider engagements, delivering compelling access strategies and business reviews.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, MPH, PharmD, or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10–12+ years of progressive experience in Market Access, Managed Markets, Reimbursement, or Commercial Strategy within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including leading Field Reimbursement, Market Access, or Patient Support teams.
  • Strong experience with specialty pharmaceuticals, oncology, biologics, and buy-and-bill products.
  • Deep knowledge of Medicare Part B and Part D, payer contracting, coding/coverage strategies, and government pricing programs.
  • Proven track record supporting product launches and commercialization in complex reimbursement environments.
  • Experience managing relationships with payers, specialty distributors, specialty pharmacies, and provider networks.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and execution in market access & reimbursement
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen (pricing, contracting, GTN)
  • Outstanding cross-functional leadership and communication skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, patient-focused environment

Travel: 30–50% (to meet with payers, providers, distributors, and field teams)

The Dendreon Way

We are guided by our core values:

  • Put Patients First
  • Act with Integrity
  • Build Trust
  • Raise the Bar
  • Drive Results

If you are passionate about expanding access to life-changing cancer therapies and want to join a high-performing team committed to making the battle against cancer personal, we want to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of immunotherapy.

Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Senior Wealth Advisor, Practice Lead plays a vital role in helping clients achieve long-term financial success by serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for moderate- and high-net-worth households. This role is focused on retaining and growing net assets over time by delivering proactive, tailored financial advice through a highly personal and strategic approach.

At Empower, our mission is to empower financial freedom for all, and our vision is to transform financial lives through advice, people, and technology. As a Sr. Wealth Advisor, you bring that mission and vision to life—ensuring that every client interaction is Easy, Personal, and Enlightening.

While not a people management position, this role will set the tone for how the team shows up for clients: leading with empathy, clarity, and insight to deliver a first-class experience.

Guide clients through portfolio strategy conversations and financial planning decisions that align with their long-term goals. By building trust and delivering a consistently exceptional experience, you'll deepen relationships, increase engagement, and strengthen net asset retention and growth.

What You Will Do

raw.description:
Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by over 60,000 women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We're hiring board-certified Nurse Practitioners who want to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to women who have historically been underserved. To learn more about our mission and clinical approach, visit .

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments and develop personalized treatment plans via video visits

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team to deliver the highest standards of care

  • Complete required trainings and uphold Allara's clinical policies, standards, and best practices

  • Educate patients on preventive care and wellness using evidence-based strategies

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records and complete charting in a timely manner

  • Respond to patient questions and administrative messages with clarity and care

  • Dedicate a full-time focus to patient care, including consultations and medical guidance, with prescribing when clinically appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active national board certification as a (WHNP, FNP, or similar).

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of consecutive experience as a Nurse Practitioner specializing in women's health and treating chronic conditions such as PCOS, Endometriosis, Hypothyroidism, Hashimoto’s, Metabolic Syndrome, Menopause, Fertility, Postpartum, PMDD, and Obesity.

  • Clinical Independence: Proven ability to function as an autonomous provider with strong diagnostic judgment and critical thinking skills

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on compassion and clarity

  • Webside Manner: A natural ability to build trust and connection with patients in a virtual setting

  • Evidence-Based Practice: A genuine commitment to delivering care rooted in current clinical research

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working across multiple platforms including EMR systems, text expanders, Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, and scheduling tools

  • Telemedicine Experience: Prior telehealth experience is a plus

  • State License Requirements & Hiring Considerations: An active, unrestricted, and unencumbered professional license in CA AND one of the following states, CO, IL (autonomous), MD (autonomous), or VA (autonomous), is required for this role.

A note on state licensing: All active and pending licenses held at the time of application are collected and reviewed during our process. Hiring decisions reflect current state-level needs, which evolve. Applicants may not move forward immediately if there is no active need in their licensed states. We regularly revisit candidates as needs expand and when experience, licensure, and role requirements align.

What Allara Offers

  • Annual base salary range: $120,000 – $130,000, and can increase up to $172,500 - $182,500 through our incentive compensation program.

    • Final base salary & incentive range is commensurate with years of relevant experience.

  • Health and Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Future Planning: 401(k) plan

  • Time Off: Annual vacation, sick days, and holidays

  • CME/WFH: Annual stipend

  • CME: Annual PTO days

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set your schedule within full-time hour requirements

  • Malpractice Insurance: Comprehensive coverage provided at no cost to you

  • Mission-Driven Work: Help transform the standard of care for women living with conditions that have historically been underdiagnosed and undertreated

  • Collaborative Provider Network: Connect with and learn from a community of skilled, like-minded Allara clinicians

  • Inclusive Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team that values innovation, equity, and belonging

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

raw.title: Expression of Interest (United States)
raw.excerpt: Electricity grids are undergoing the most significant transformation in a century.
raw.description:
Electricity grids are undergoing the most significant transformation in a century. The shift to renewables, the proliferation of rooftop solar, batteries and EVs, and the increasing complexity of distribution networks are forcing utilities to operate their grids in fundamentally new ways. Gridsight's vertical SaaS platform uses data, ML and AI to help grid operators modernise their operations and unlock transformational new capabilities. We deliver visibility into the grid edge, faster renewable connections, and real-time orchestration of distributed energy. The opportunity is enormous ($1B+ ARR).

We're embedded with over 50% of Australia's distribution networks, more than 30% in New Zealand, and have 1 of the top 5 utilities in the US as our lighthouse. Airtree led our Series A, we grew ARR 3.4x in the past 6 months, we are well funded and we're on the path to build the first truly generational utility software company.

We are a team of builders. What unites us is that we’re curious, hungry and obsessed with maximising the impact we can deliver to Gridsight and the energy transition.

The Role:

If you're here it's because what we're building at Gridsight resonates with you, but you haven't found a role that quite fits you (if you haven't looked, view all of our current openings here).

At Gridsight, we hire exceptional people - even when they don’t fit neatly into an open role.
We care less about pedigree, titles, or a perfectly matched résumé. Above all, we care about four things:

  • Bias for impact: You pursue meaningful outcomes and make things happen.
  • Exceptional learning: You learn unusually quickly and turn insight into action.
  • Deep motivation: You’re hungry to do ambitious work and raise the bar.
  • Low ego: You seek truth, welcome feedback, and care more about the result than the credit.

If you genuinely epitomise these four things, we would rather shape a role around you than miss the chance to work with you.

Think this is you?

Share what you've done, how you made an impact, and why Gridsight speaks to you - in whatever format works best for you.

This is an opportunity for those looking to do their life's work. If you're hungry to tackle challenging problems alongside exceptional people, we want to hear from you. If that isn't you, self select out now.

We review submissions to our Expressions of Interest opening on the 1st and 3rd Monday of each month and reach out to those who leave an indelible mark.

raw.description:
Overview

Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in weather and climate science. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts. As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced API Developer to join our growing team.

Responsibilities

Duties of the API Developer will include the following:

  • API development: design and build APIs that ingest structured data and serve results to downstream users and applications.
  • Structured outputs: generate versioned, schema-conformant outputs in multiple formats, including PDF and JSON, that faithfully represent the underlying data.
  • Schemas & versioning: define and maintain output schemas, data contracts, and schema and API versioning, using standards such as OpenAPI and JSON Schema, so consumers can rely on stable interfaces as the system evolves.
  • CLI (secondary): provide a lightweight command-line interface over the same functionality for scripted and batch use.
  • Security & deployment: help package and deploy services soundly, applying good practices for access control, dependency management, and compliance in secure or government-adjacent environments.
  • Testing & validation: write unit and integration tests and output-validation checks to confirm results are correct, well-formed, and reproducible.
  • Documentation & collaboration: document APIs, schemas, and output formats; coordinate with the Science and Platform teams that define the underlying data and logic to keep interfaces clear.

Qualifications

The API Developer selected should have the following:

  • Master's in computer science, software engineering, data science, or a related field; or a Bachelor's plus 1-2 years building APIs, services, or data pipelines; or equivalent practical experience, including military or self-taught paths.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language; Python experience is a plus, as it is the likely production language for this work.
  • Experience designing and consuming REST/JSON APIs and working with structured data formats.
  • Understanding of data schemas and versioning, and why stable data contracts matter to downstream consumers.
  • Comfort with Git, Linux, testing, and command-line workflows.

The Ideal API Developer will have the following:

  • Experience generating documents or reports programmatically (e.g., PDF generation) and producing multiple output formats from a single source of truth.
  • Familiarity with schema definition and validation tooling (e.g., JSON Schema) and format versioning practices.
  • Exposure to environmental, geospatial, or scientific data, and formats such as GeoJSON or GeoParquet.
  • Experience with containerization, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD for reliable, repeatable builds and deployments (e.g., Docker, Terraform or CloudFormation, GitHub Actions).
  • Systems, infrastructure, or networking experience, and familiarity with secure deployment on AWS (e.g., access management, or a security credential such as CC or Security+).
  • Experience with R, including Shiny, or other languages for data apps and rapid prototyping.
  • Familiarity with Rust or an interest in contributing to Rust-based tooling.
  • Colorado Front Range presence for periodic in-person collaboration.

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

  • Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
  • Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
  • Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
  • Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
  • Spot bonuses for exceptional performance
  • Annual Employee Recognition Awards with bonuses
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Free centralized, self-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace
  • Personalized career growth plans for every employee

Lynker is an E-Verify employer.

Lynker is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local laws.

raw.description:
Job Description:

We’re KSM, one of the top 50 largest independent advisory, tax, and audit firms in the United States. But more than our size, it’s our people and culture that set us apart. We believe great things happen when people are supported, challenged, and given the freedom to do their very best work. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where your career and personal life can thrive together – where you have the flexibility to manage your time, the resources to grow, and a team that genuinely cares about your success.

We’ve been employee-owned since 2001, giving every team member a stake in our collective success. This ownership mentality fosters a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and excellence – where new ideas are welcomed, different perspectives are valued, and you’re encouraged to explore what excites you most. Whether you’re expanding your skills, tackling new challenges, or making an impact beyond the office, we provide the resources and support to help you grow in the direction that’s right for you.

At KSM, your contributions matter – not just to the firm, but to your colleagues, clients, and the communities we serve across the U.S. If you’re looking for a place where you can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow in ways that align with what’s most important to you, we’d love to meet you.

Position Summary:

Katz, Sapper & Miller (KSM) is seeking an accomplished Sales & Use Tax Senior Manager to help lead and expand our growing State and Local Tax (SALT) practice. This is an opportunity for an experienced sales tax professional to make a meaningful impact by combining advanced multistate technical expertise with practice leadership, business development, and team development.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, independently leading complex multistate sales and use tax engagements and delivering practical, high-quality solutions to sophisticated technical issues. Equally important, this individual will help shape the future of the practice by strengthening client relationships, mentoring and developing professionals, enhancing processes, championing innovation, and supporting strategic growth initiatives.

We are looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking leader who demonstrates sound professional judgment, intellectual curiosity, and an ownership mindset. The ideal candidate is passionate about building high-performing teams, identifying opportunities to improve how we serve clients, and contributing to the continued evolution and long-term success of KSM's Sales & Use Tax practice.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage sales and use engagements performed within the SALT Group, and ensure accurate and timely deliverables while providing strategic oversight
  • Exercise sound judgment in managing day-to-day client matters independently while appropriately escalating strategic or high-risk issues.
  • Create an environment where managers, seniors, and staff are challenged, coached, and developed into future leaders through meaningful feedback, delegation, and mentoring
  • Develop and enhance their own technical understanding of SALT specialty areas
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive culture within the SALT practice while strengthening relationships across service lines to increase awareness of SALT capabilities and enhance client service.
  • Serve as Firm technical resource for multistate sales and use tax issues
  • Lead sales and use tax practice initiatives, process improvements, and service offerings.
  • Collaborate across service lines to identify integrated client solutions and expand existing client relationships
  • Champion continuous improvement by evaluating emerging technologies, AI tools, and workflow enhancements that improve quality, efficiency, and the client experience
  • Represent the firm through speaking, publications, and professional organizations.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • Keep abreast of SALT developments nationwide; communicate to Firm.
  • Develop and enhance excellent technical knowledge, writing skills and verbal communication skills; interpret, complete and review opinion papers, protest documents, internal technical communications, etc.
  • Perform complex tax research; manage tax research projects; utilize managers, seniors and staff when appropriate.
  • Develop deep understanding of client business and industries to provide solutions to SALT related issues
  • Develop and advise on strategies to minimize sales and use tax burden of clients
  • Assist with business restructuring projects with a significant SALT component.
  • Manage state and local tax audits; demonstrate ability to advocate client positions in audit and other potentially adversarial settings with state and local government officials while maintaining positive relationships with government personnel and directing client communications to set expectations.
  • Build and maintain relationships with peer government officials for assistance with various client issues; develop and maintain relationships with professional colleagues within the tax community.
  • Demonstrate the ability to generate high-quality work under deadlines and within budgets; outstanding ability to multi-task within and outside of the firm and across multiple clients, assignments and staff to meet often tight deadlines
  • Manage the economics and profitability of projects.
  • Become an integral part of the technical and professional development of staff; serve as a formal and informal mentor to managers, seniors and staff.
  • Participate in public speaking on technical topics to internal and external audiences.
  • Embrace and promote technology-enabled service delivery, including AI tools and automation, to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability across the practice.
  • Collaborate with Partners and Directors to expand existing client relationships, identify new business opportunities, develop referral networks, participate in community and industry activities, and contribute to the long-term strategic growth of the practice.

Leadership Competencies:

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strong professional judgment and accountability
  • A positive, collaborative leadership style
  • An ownership mindset with a bias toward action
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning
  • Comfort operating in an evolving, growth-oriented environment
  • Ability to develop future leaders through coaching and mentoring
  • Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence
  • Entrepreneurial thinking balanced with practical execution and risk management

Required Experience:

  • A minimum of 10 calendar years of state and local tax experience, demonstrating a proven progression in complexity of tax issues addressed.
  • CPA or CMI preferred.
  • Proficiency in complex state and local tax research.
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in accounting and/or taxation, or advanced degree (e.g., law degree) and related work experience.
  • Minimum of forty hours of continuing professional education is required each year to maintain and develop technical and business skills.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring and developing high-performing teams
  • Proficiency in use of tax compliance software, legal research software, and suite of Microsoft Office programs.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.

KSM only accepts resumes directly submitted by a candidate and referrals submitted by current KSM employees. Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent by staffing agencies and fee-based referral services will not be considered outside of a signed KSM vendor contract. KSM will not pay a fee to recruiters or agencies that do not have a signed KSM vendor contract.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You Will Do

1. Brand & Visual Strategy

  • Own BJAK’s brand identity and visual systems across all platforms

  • Build a UK-first visual narrative tailored to local users, culture, and market trends

  • Translate marketing and business objectives into impactful visual storytelling

  • Develop creative campaigns that build awareness, trust, and adoption

  • Ensure consistent brand expression across digital, social, product, and offline channels

2. Creative Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a small, multidisciplinary creative team

  • Set high standards for design quality, speed, and execution

  • Review and approve visual assets to ensure alignment with the brand vision

  • Foster a collaborative, high-ownership, and execution-driven team culture

3. Execution & Optimization

  • Build and manage creative workflows balancing quality, speed, and scalability

  • Partner with growth, product, and leadership teams to align visuals with strategic goals

  • Use data, insights, and market trends to optimize campaigns and creative output

  • Stay up-to-date on consumer, design, and digital trends to keep the brand relevant

You Will Thrive Here If You…

  • Care deeply about visual storytelling, brand building, and design excellence

  • Are hands-on, fast-moving, and obsessed with execution quality

  • Lead confidently while staying close to the work

  • Perform well under pressure and ambiguity

  • Take ownership of projects end-to-end and drive for measurable impact

  • Continuously push for higher standards and better outcomes

  • Manage multiple projects efficiently without losing structure or focus

  • Communicate clearly and provide actionable, constructive feedback

  • Want to build something meaningful in the market, fast and at scale

What You Bring

  • 4–6 years of experience in visual design, brand design, or creative leadership

  • Strong portfolio showcasing visual storytelling, digital campaigns, and multi-channel projects

  • Deep understanding of branding, design systems, and digital content strategy

  • Proven experience leading creative teams and raising creative standards

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, and modern production workflows

  • Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills

  • Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or high-growth consumer brands

  • Experience building or localizing brands

Our Team & Culture

  • Lean, high-output team that moves fast and expects the same from everyone

  • Everyone contributes meaningfully, thinks like an owner, and raises the bar

  • Clarity, execution, and iteration drive everything we do

  • Results, speed, and ownership matter more than titles

Location

This role is based in Japan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
